candidates.source_name: AJPES ePRS - Poslovni register Slovenije (public search)
candidates.why_relevant: Master population register of every Slovenian business entity, including banks, payment institutions and e-money issuers. Public entity records carry legal representatives (zastopniki), scope of representation and appointment/termination dates, so every change of director or board member is legally recorded here. Also the definitive list of employer entities that all other A5 cells (jobs, hiring, leadership moves) should be searched against.
candidates.legal_status: official public register; personal-data fields restricted by ZSReg-E amendments
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scripted lookup by matricna stevilka / davcna stevilka for a watchlist of SI banking & payments entities; diff representative lists between snapshots to detect leadership changes. Respect per-user daily query caps; prefer the OPSI bulk dataset for population-wide sweeps.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from AJPES service pages
queries_used: AJPES ePRS poslovni register sprememba zastopnika banka
AJPES business register Slovenia legal representative change bank

candidates.source_name: AJPES Poslovni register Slovenije - open data on OPSI (podatki.gov.si)
candidates.why_relevant: Bulk/open-data distribution of the Slovenian Business Register. Enables building the full employer population for SI banking & payments (by SKD activity codes 64/65/66) in one pass rather than entity-by-entity lookups, and re-downloading periodically to diff entity creations, status changes and (where present) representation data.
candidates.legal_status: open data portal of the Republic of Slovenia; licence stated per dataset
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled dataset download + local diffing; filter to SKD K64/K65/K66 activity codes. Verify which fields (representatives vs. base identifiers) are actually included before relying on it for leadership detection.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result snowball from AJPES seed query
queries_used: AJPES ePRS poslovni register sprememba zastopnika banka

candidates.source_name: AJPES Uradne objave - eObjave vpisov v sodni register (court register entry publications)
candidates.why_relevant: This is the highest-value single feed for the cell: AJPES publishes every court-register entry decision, including entries of changes of management board members (clani uprave), supervisory board members (clani nadzornega sveta) and representatives, with the decision date. It converts a leadership rumour into a dated, legally confirmed fact, and surfaces changes that were never announced in a press release.
candidates.legal_status: statutory publication under Zakon o sodnem registru (ZSReg); some personal data suppressed by ZSReg-E; older publications may age out (noted retention windows of ~1 year for some publication types)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily polling of the eObjave search filtered to the SI banking/payments entity watchlist; parse the decision text for uprava / nadzorni svet / zastopnik keywords and appointment dates. Archive locally because of the limited retention window.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language query on sodni register publications
queries_used: AJPES eObjave objave sodnega registra vpis spremembe zastopnikov iskalnik
sodni register vpis sprememba članov uprave banka Slovenija

candidates.source_name: Sodni register RS (Slovenian court register) - AJPES access point
candidates.why_relevant: The court register is the constitutive register for d.d. / d.o.o. entities: management and supervisory board composition and representation powers take legal effect on entry here. It is the authoritative cross-check on any claimed leadership move at a Slovenian bank or payment institution, and its document collection (zbirka listin) reveals shareholder resolutions on appointments and dismissals.
candidates.legal_status: statutory register; access to public data changed by ZSReg-E - confirm current access rules before automated collection
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/assisted lookups per entity for confirmation events rather than bulk scraping; pair with the eObjave feed which carries the same events in publication form.
queries_used: sodni register vpis sprememba članov uprave banka Slovenija eSodstvo

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register subjektov nadzora (register of supervised entities)
candidates.why_relevant: Single consolidated searchable register of ~372 supervised entities: banks and savings banks, EEA credit institutions operating in SI, payment institutions, e-money issuers, money changers (menjalci) and payment system operators. This is the canonical employer universe for the whole SI banking & payments run - every other A5 cell should be searched against this list.
candidates.legal_status: official register published by the national competent authority
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the register listing (paginated) into a canonical entity table with names, websites and category; re-run monthly and diff for new authorisations, withdrawals and category changes. Entity websites harvested here feed the careers-page cell.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + direct fetch of the register page
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja seznam

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register of payment institutions (EN)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative list of payment institutions licensed or registered by Banka Slovenije, published with their representatives and branches. New authorisations are the strongest leading indicator of new payments employers about to hire in SI; the representative field doubles as a leadership-change signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape of both the SL and EN pages (SL is usually updated first); diff entity list and representative names.
queries_used: EBA payment institutions register Slovenia list

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja (e-money issuers)
candidates.why_relevant: Register of e-money institutions holding a valid Banka Slovenije licence, published together with their representatives and branches, plus a separate list of entities that have ceased issuing e-money. Direct evidence of both new employers entering the SI payments market and organisational wind-downs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape; track the 'ceased' list separately as a downsizing/exit signal.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja seznam

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Plačilne institucije držav EGP v Sloveniji (EEA passported payment institutions)
candidates.why_relevant: Lists EEA payment institutions passporting into Slovenia, including which operate through a branch or agent in SI. Branch/agent establishment is a concrete organisation-change and local-hiring signal for foreign payments players that would otherwise be invisible in SI-domiciled registers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape; flag entries that establish a SI branch or agent as high-priority hiring leads.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja seznam

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Nadzor nebančnih ponudnikov plačilnih storitev (AISP / PISP oversight hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Hub page for supervision of non-bank payment service providers, including account information service providers (ponudniki storitev zagotavljanja informacij o racunih). Points to the registration lists and the registration request forms - the entry point for identifying newly registered AISPs, which are typically small, fast-hiring fintech employers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl this hub to enumerate all downstream registers/lists it links to, then monitor each; cross-check AISP entries against the EBA PIR which explicitly carries AISP records.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register ponudnikov storitev informiranja o računih AISP seznam
local_language_terms_used: ponudniki storitev zagotavljanja informacij o računih

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register serviserjev kreditov (credit servicers register)
candidates.why_relevant: Register of credit servicers authorised to operate in Slovenia, plus the related registers of consumer real-estate credit intermediaries (posredniki potrosniskih kreditov za nepremicnine) and real-estate financial lease providers. These extend the employer population beyond banks/PIs into adjacent credit-servicing firms that hire the same operational profiles.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the individual register sub-pages from the supervised-entities hub and scrape each quarterly. Exact sub-page URLs were observed as links from the hub but not individually confirmed - treat deep URLs as unverified until resolved.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the supervised-entities register page
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja seznam

candidates.source_name: EBA EUCLID - Payment Institutions Register (PIR), filterable to Slovenia
candidates.why_relevant: Pan-EEA register of payment institutions, e-money institutions, AISPs, their agents and branches, plus excluded and formerly authorised entities, searchable by country and competent authority. Filtering to SI gives a machine-readable, comparably structured mirror of the Banka Slovenije registers and additionally exposes agents - a population invisible in most national views.
candidates.legal_status: official EU register under PSD2 Art. 15
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the register filtered to country=SI on a monthly cadence, capture authorisation status transitions (authorised / withdrawn / expired) as organisation-change events. Check for a bulk download or JSON endpoint behind the search UI before scraping HTML.
candidates.discovered_via_method: English seed query + snowball to EUCLID
queries_used: EBA payment institutions register Slovenia list
euclid.eba.europa.eu register pir search payment institutions register

candidates.source_name: EBA EUCLID - Credit Institutions Register (CIR), filterable to Slovenia
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative EU-level list of authorised credit institutions per member state, built from competent-authority submissions. Filtering to SI yields the definitive bank population with LEIs and authorisation dates - the identifier backbone for joining register data to job postings, news and leadership records.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic country-filtered export; use as the canonical bank identifier table (name + LEI + authorisation status) for entity resolution across all cells.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions Slovenia list

candidates.source_name: ATVP - Registri (securities market agency registers hub)
candidates.why_relevant: ATVP maintains public registers of licences for investment services and investment fund management, covering brokerage firms (borznoposredniske druzbe), management companies (druzbe za upravljanje) and banks authorised for investment services. It also licenses individual roles, so its registers expose named licensed persons - a rare register-grade source of individual-level movement in the SI financial sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the registers hub to enumerate each individual register, then scrape each quarterly; diff licensed-entity and licensed-person lists.
queries_used: ATVP register borznoposredniških družb družb za upravljanje seznam nadzorovanih subjektov

candidates.source_name: ATVP - Register odvisnih borznoposredniskih zastopnikov (tied agents register)
candidates.why_relevant: Publicly accessible register of tied investment agents established in Slovenia, naming individuals/entities and the firm on whose behalf they act. Changes in this register are a person-level indicator of moves between financial firms - the kind of granular leadership/staff movement other cells cannot confirm.
candidates.legal_status: official register; contains personal data - process under legitimate-interest assessment and minimise storage
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly snapshot + diff on the agent-to-firm mapping; handle personal data with a documented GDPR basis and retention limit.
queries_used: ATVP register borznoposredniških družb družb za upravljanje seznam nadzorovanih subjektov

candidates.source_name: ATVP - Seznam javnih druzb (list of public companies)
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates Slovenian issuers subject to disclosure obligations, which includes listed banks. Public-company status is what forces timely disclosure of management and supervisory board appointments, so this list identifies exactly which SI banking employers will produce dated, regulated leadership announcements.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Semi-annual scrape; use the result to prioritise regulated-disclosure monitoring for those issuers in other cells.
queries_used: ATVP register borznoposredniških družb družb za upravljanje seznam nadzorovanih subjektov

candidates.source_name: AJPES JOLP - Javna objava letnih porocil (public disclosure of annual reports)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory annual reports for all SI business entities including banks. Reports carry average number of employees, personnel costs and governance/board sections - i.e. a hard, comparable headcount time series per employer and named board composition per financial year. This is the register-anchored ground truth against which job-ad-derived hiring signals should be calibrated.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual pull after the JOLP publication date for the watchlist entities. IMPORTANT documented constraint: a daily cap of 20 business entities per user account; spread collection across days or request a higher quota from AJPES at info@ajpes.si rather than circumventing it.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language query on annual report publication
queries_used: AJPES JOLP javna objava letnih poročil število zaposlenih iskanje
candidates.observed_blocker: Documented limit of 20 business entities per user name per day on publicly disclosed annual-report data; higher quota available on request to AJPES.

candidates.source_name: AJPES Register transakcijskih racunov (RTR)
candidates.why_relevant: Register of transaction accounts linking every SI business entity to the bank holding its account. As a pointer it enumerates the set of account-servicing institutions actually operating in SI and lets an analyst map which banks serve which segments - useful for sizing employers and for detecting bank exits/mergers reflected in account migrations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use for entity-to-bank mapping lookups rather than continuous monitoring; check for the published bulk/open-data variant.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register ponudnikov storitev informiranja o računih AISP seznam

candidates.source_name: European e-Justice Portal - BRIS company search (Slovenia via AJPES)
candidates.why_relevant: BRIS queries the Slovenian business register in real time through AJPES, and covers d.d./d.o.o. entities and their cross-border branches. Useful as a fee-free, standardised fallback route to SI entity records - and specifically for spotting SI branches of foreign banking/payments groups and foreign branches of SI institutions, which are organisation-change events.
candidates.legal_status: official EU portal; real-time pass-through to national registers
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Ad-hoc entity verification and cross-border branch discovery; not suited to bulk collection (real-time pass-through, no bulk export).
candidates.discovered_via_method: English snowball query on register interconnection
queries_used: e-justice europa BRIS business registers interconnection search company Slovenia

candidates.source_name: AJPES Evidenca digitalnih potrdil zastopnikov (EDP - register of representatives' digital certificates)
candidates.why_relevant: A sub-collection of the PRS recording which natural persons are registered as representatives able to act electronically for an entity. Conceptually it is a second, operational confirmation of who currently signs for a bank or payment institution, and changes to it track representation changes.
candidates.legal_status: contains personal data tied to authentication; public access is unlikely - confirm before any collection
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not collect. Record as context only; rely on ePRS representative data and eObjave for the same signal.
candidates.discovered_via_method: content of AJPES public-services description page
queries_used: AJPES ePRS poslovni register sprememba zastopnika banka
candidates.observed_blocker: Described as an internal authentication-support collection of the PRS; no public search interface identified.

candidates.source_name: Uradni list RS - publications of Banka Slovenije decisions and register-related regulations
candidates.why_relevant: The official gazette carries the statutes governing the court/business registers (ZSReg, Uredba o vpisu druzb v sodni register) and certain regulator decisions. It defines what must be registered and disclosed, which determines what our register-monitoring can legally expect to see, and it is the archival source when register pages change.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-monitored search for register/licensing acts affecting banks and payment institutions; use mainly to keep the collection rules for other register sources current.
queries_used: sodni register vpis sprememba članov uprave banka Slovenija eSodstvo

negative_findings.description: No public API or bulk-download endpoint for the AJPES ePRS representative (zastopnik) data was identified through search. The ePRS web interface appears to be the only confirmed public access path, and AJPES separately documents per-user daily query caps on related services.
negative_findings.result_summary: ePRS confirmed as a web search interface; no API documentation surfaced in sl or en queries.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Systematic monitoring of every SI banking/payments entity's representatives may require either the OPSI bulk dataset (field coverage unconfirmed) or a commercial data licence from AJPES; this affects collection design and cost.

negative_findings.description: Searches surfaced an AJPES notice that access to public court-register data changed following the ZSReg-E amendment, including suppression of EMSO and of personal data not directly connected to the role, and a ~1-year retention window for some published decisions. The exact current access rules for automated retrieval were not established.
negative_findings.result_summary: Access change confirmed to exist; precise post-ZSReg-E rules not determined.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-change detection depends on personal names remaining published. If suppression is broader than assumed, the court-register route degrades and the run must lean more on regulator registers and corporate announcements. Also implies eObjave must be archived locally before items age out.

negative_findings.description: The Banka Slovenije supervised-entities hub page lists sub-registers (credit intermediaries, real-estate financial lease providers, credit servicers, list of companies requiring BS consent for insolvency proceedings) but the individual deep URLs for each were observed only as on-page links and were not separately resolved. They are recorded against the hub URL rather than invented.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sub-registers confirmed to exist; individual URLs not captured.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A follow-up crawl of the hub is needed to produce directly addressable, monitorable URLs for each sub-register.

negative_findings.description: Searching in Slovenian for a standalone register of account information service providers returned only the general supervised-entities register and the non-bank PSP oversight hub - no dedicated AISP register page was identified on bsi.si.
negative_findings.result_summary: AISPs appear to be carried inside the consolidated Register subjektov nadzora and in the EBA PIR rather than in a separate SI list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: AISP monitoring should be driven off the EBA PIR (country=SI) plus the consolidated BS register, not off a presumed dedicated national page.

negative_findings.description: Queries for Slovenian commercial company-data aggregators (bizi.si, gvin.com) that resell register data with director histories did not return substantive confirmation of those services or their coverage of representative-change history.
negative_findings.result_summary: No verified commercial aggregator source captured for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Commercial aggregators are usually the only practical way to get historical representative-change time series rather than current-state snapshots; this remains an unexplored acquisition option.

coverage_gaps.description: All confirmed register sources expose current state (who is a representative now, which entities are licensed now). No confirmed source provides a historical time series of representative changes with effective dates, other than the eObjave publication stream, which has a limited retention window.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Stand up local archiving of the AJPES eObjave feed immediately so history accumulates from run start; investigate an AJPES data licence or a commercial aggregator for backfill.

coverage_gaps.description: AZN (Agencija za zavarovalni nadzor, insurance supervision) registers were not searched. Bancassurance and insurance-adjacent payments employers therefore fall outside the enumerated population if the sector definition includes them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up local-language sweep for 'AZN register zavarovalnic zavarovalnih zastopnikov' if insurance-adjacent employers are in scope.

coverage_gaps.description: Banka Slovenije must approve bank management board members (dovoljenje za opravljanje funkcije clana uprave banke). No published list or decision feed of such approvals was located, although it would be the single most precise leadership-move source in the SI banking sector.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted follow-up queries in Slovenian for 'dovoljenje za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave banke Banka Slovenije odločbe' and a check of the BS decisions/odlocbe section; if no public feed exists, record as a structural gap.

coverage_gaps.description: Register sources use different identifiers (maticna stevilka in AJPES, entity names in BS registers, LEI in EBA registers). No confirmed crosswalk was established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and test an entity-resolution table joining maticna stevilka, LEI and canonical names using the EBA CIR/PIR exports plus the BS supervised-entities list, before downstream cells consume register output.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the JOLP daily cap (20 entities/user/day) was concretely documented. Robots.txt and terms-of-use for ajpes.si, bsi.si, a-tvp.si and euclid.eba.europa.eu were not reviewed, so automated collection is not yet cleared.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Before any scraping, review robots.txt and terms for each of the four domains and set conservative crawl rates; prefer official bulk/open-data channels where they exist.

brief: Slovenia's register landscape for leadership and organisation change is unusually strong and highly centralised: AJPES holds the population and representation layer (ePRS, the court register and its eObjave publication stream, plus JOLP annual reports with headcount), while Banka Slovenije's consolidated Register subjektov nadzora enumerates roughly 372 supervised entities across banks, payment institutions, e-money issuers and payment system operators, with ATVP covering the investment-services side including a person-level tied-agent register. The EBA EUCLID CIR and PIR registers mirror the SI population in a standardised, country-filterable form and additionally expose agents and passporting entities, making them the best identifier backbone for joining register data to job and news signals. The binding constraints are historical depth and access regime rather than availability: registers show current state, the eObjave feed that carries dated appointment decisions appears to have a limited retention window, personal-data publication was narrowed by the ZSReg-E amendment, and JOLP is explicitly capped at 20 entity lookups per user per day. Two structural gaps warrant immediate follow-up - no located public feed of Banka Slovenije fit-and-proper approvals for bank management board members, and no verified commercial aggregator offering historical representative-change series.
